html:
G'oya

Avval oraliq. Bugun 2024-06-10 kirmaydi, undan oldingi 7 kun: 3-iyundan 9-iyungacha. entered_at da vaqt bor, shuning uchun oraliqni yarim ochiq yozamiz: 2024-06-03 00:00 dan (kiradi) 2024-06-10 00:00 gacha (kirmaydi). Keyin har a'zoning kirishlarini kunga aylantirib, takrorsiz sanaymiz va HAVING bilan 3 dan kamlarini tashlaymiz.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT m.id, m.name, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(e.entered_at AS DATE)) AS days
FROM members m
JOIN entries e ON e.member_id = m.id
WHERE e.entered_at >= DATE '2024-06-10' - 7
  AND e.entered_at < DATE '2024-06-10'
GROUP BY m.id, m.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(e.entered_at AS DATE)) >= 3
Faqat SQLiteSELECT m.id, m.name, COUNT(DISTINCT date(e.entered_at)) AS days
FROM members m
JOIN entries e ON e.member_id = m.id
WHERE e.entered_at >= date('2024-06-10', '-7 days')
  AND e.entered_at < '2024-06-10'
GROUP BY m.id, m.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT date(e.entered_at)) >= 3

COUNT(DISTINCT kun) bir kundagi bir necha kirishni bitta qiladi. Bekzodning 3-iyun 00:00 dagi kirishi oraliqqa kiradi, 2-iyun 23:50 dagisi esa yo'q.

Tuzoqlar

COUNT(*) kirishlarni sanaydi. Malika 4-iyunda ikki marta kelgan, 6-iyunda bir marta: kun ikkita, kirish uchta, va u noto'g'ri ravishda ro'yxatga tushadi.

Bugungi kunni qo'shib yuborish oson: < '2024-06-11' yoki BETWEEN ... AND CURRENT_DATE. Malikaning bugungi ertalabki kirishi uni yana uchinchi kunga yetkazadi.

BETWEEN '2024-06-03' AND '2024-06-09' ham xato. '2024-06-09' aslida 9-iyun 00:00:00, Azizning 21:30 dagi kirishi oraliqdan chiqib qoladi:

Noto'g'riSELECT m.id, m.name, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBSTR(CAST(e.entered_at AS TEXT), 1, 10)) AS days
FROM members m
JOIN entries e ON e.member_id = m.id
WHERE e.entered_at BETWEEN '2024-06-03' AND '2024-06-09'
GROUP BY m.id, m.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SUBSTR(CAST(e.entered_at AS TEXT), 1, 10)) >= 3

BETWEEN ni sanaga aylantirilgan ustunga qo'llasangiz (date(e.entered_at) BETWEEN ...), to'g'ri ishlaydi.
